summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on George Allan England, an American writer and explorer who lived from 1877 to 1936. He is best known for speculative and science fiction, and he attended Harvard University. The entry also notes that he unsuccessfully ran for Governor of Maine and was a socialist whose works often carry socialist themes.
one_line: Biographical entry on George Allan England, American speculative fiction writer, explorer, Harvard alumnus, and socialist.
key_facts: George Allan England was born on 9 February 1877.
George Allan England died on 26 June 1936.
